messages:
lara: Heads up — spotted a customer on Dedicated hit autofallback to 'degraded-primary' and the ratecard shows a weird spike. Do we attribute tokens to the fallback model or the original route? Need UX + ops handshake.

owen: FWIW our pipeline currently credits the model that actually produced the tokens. In this case fallback switched to a smaller model so raw per-token cost dropped, but console shows token count doubled. Suspect double-counting from prefix replay + KV cache metrics.

tia: Can you paste the trace id and the policy name? Agree we should show 'fallback_reason' and a per-variant token breakdown in the billing panel.

lara: trace=abc123. Policy=auto-fallback:latency>150ms. Console only shows aggregate tokens and a single cost line. No way to tell which model served which tokens.

ash: Proposal: add explicit billing attribution fields: model_inference_model_id and model_inference_tokens. Also expose fallback_variant in telemetry so the UI can render a stacked breakdown. Quick API sketch:

```json
POST /v1/telemetry/events
{
  "event":"inference_complete",
  "model_id":"redwood-small",
  "tokens":123,
  "fallback_from":"redwood-large",
  "fallback_reason":"latency",
  "trace_id":"abc123"
}
```

ops-bot: Deploy: canary of `fallback-billing-patch` started at 2025-03-01T12:02Z :rocket:

tia: Also add audit events for fallback_trigger with structured keys: reason, from_model, to_model, operator (auto/human). Needs to be queryable in the Console and the Events API.

owen: Edge case — KV cache/prefix replay: if some tokens were served from original host's cache and others from fallback, attribution is mixed. Suggest adding an `attribution_mode` flag (exact | estimated | mixed_kv) and an 'estimated_share' column.

lara: For UX: show a small 'mixed model' badge in the route billing row with a tooltip that explains attribution and links to a runbook. Also surface a 'per-model tokens' expandable breakdown. Can billing team sign off on how we label that?

ash: I'll open a tiny PR that adds the telemetry fields + a minimal console mock. Internal link: http://go/patch/123 (mock images + data). Pinging @billing-team for buy-in.

sam: SGTM from billing. We also want an alert if autofallback causes >20% month-over-month delta in billed tokens or cost for a customer.

lara: :thumbsup: OK — next steps: triage in ops sync. Owners: eng-platform (owen + tia) for telemetry + backend, ash for UI, billing (sam) for labeling/alerts. I'll drop the runbook link into the ticket.
